embeds.description:
**Actor:** Mr_Rot13
A threat actor named Mr_Rot13 has been attributed to exploiting CVE-2026-41940, a critical cPanel and WebHost Manager authentication bypass vulnerability, to deploy a backdoor codenamed Filemanager. According to QiAnXin XLab, more than 2,000 attacker source IPs worldwide are involved in automated attacks exploiting this vulnerability, with malicious activities including cryptocurrency mining, ransomware deployment, botnet propagation, and backdoor implantation. The attack chain involves downloading a Go-based infector via shell script, implanting SSH keys for persistence, deploying a PHP web shell for credential theft, and ultimately delivering the cross-platform Filemanager backdoor.

**CVEs:** CVE-2026-41940 • **Access:** Exploitation of CVE-2026-41940 (authentication bypass in cPanel/WHM)
